MPESB PNST Pre Nursing Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

MPESB PNST Pre Nursing Online Form 2026. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website before the last date. The last date to apply is 23/06/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Exam Name : Pre Nursing Selection Test (PNST)
  • Last Date : 23/06/2026
  • Apply Online Start Date : 09/06/2026
  • Apply Online Last Date : 23/06/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 23/06/2026
  • Correction Last Date : 28/06/2026
  • Admit Card Released Date : As Per Schedule
  • CBT Exam Date Start : 10/07/2026

Application Fee

  • Last Date : 23/06/2026
  • Apply Online Start Date : 09/06/2026
  • Apply Online Last Date : 23/06/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 23/06/2026
  • Correction Last Date : 28/06/2026
  • CBT Exam Date Start : 10/07/2026
  • General / Other State : Rs. 460/-
  • B.Sc Nursing (PNST) : 04 Years

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
